verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are mainly a software-feature axis that would normally be a category error for a GPU. The evidence, however, shows NVIDIA's first-party companion software doing one: the NVIDIA app can update hundreds of games to the latest DLSS features and models at once, so the axis applies narrowly. CUDA's parallel-compute tooling is a developer building block, not a user-facing bulk-operation feature, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: bulk operations beyond DLSS updates, any programmatic or automatable (CLI/API) bulk interface suited to AI-native workflows, detailed docs on scope and selection controls, and independent hands-on corroboration.
